method: Qualitative structural coding of public web texts/snippets plus journalism-craft teaching materials. No full copyrighted texts redistributed.

bregman.title: Why do the poor make such poor decisions?
bregman.opening: dated concrete event: Cherokee casino opening
bregman.movement: event → causal question → theory → analogy → experiments → policy
bregman.craft: abstract claim repeatedly returns to concrete cases; technical concept ('mental bandwidth') appears after reader already sees the problem
bregman.cripminds_use: model for concrete↔abstract alternation and causal discovery
bregman.caution: uses more rhetorical questions/fragments than owner preference

bregman.title: Has the time finally come for universal basic income?
bregman.opening: current crisis preface, then London 2009 experiment
bregman.carrier: 13 homeless men; later Omondi, Mincome, US experiments
bregman.movement: case → result → hard data → new case → history → politics
bregman.craft: multiple concrete cases spaced through long argument; research is selected into narrative units rather than presented as source audit
bregman.cripminds_use: model for 'gold coins along the path' and alternating cognitive registers
bregman.caution: long-form permits more examples than a short Crip Minds article should carry

bregman.title: Look at the phone in your hand – you can thank the state for that
bregman.opening: abstract rhetorical question about who drives progress
bregman.movement: myth → concrete industrial story → evidence → larger policy claim
bregman.craft: does not require a scene-first lede; turns abstraction into a concrete company, shed, machines and technologies quickly
bregman.cripminds_use: evidence that 'always open with scene' would be overfitting

bregman.title: No, wealth isn’t created at the top. It is merely devoured there
bregman.carrier: rentier mechanism + concrete sectors and occupations
bregman.movement: claim → language critique → definition → examples → political conclusion
bregman.craft: explicit thesis can work when the form is argumentative; concrete occupations keep the economics legible

bregman.title: The neoliberal era is ending. What comes next?
bregman.opening: broad political claim, then a Financial Times editorial as concrete artefact
bregman.movement: present rupture → artefact → intellectual history → policy possibilities
bregman.craft: an object/document can carry an intellectual history; alternates current event with larger context
bregman.cripminds_use: model for reported essay when there is no single protagonist
bregman.caution: high abstraction load requires more room than short feature

bregman.title: The real Lord of the Flies
bregman.opening: abstract human-nature frame → fictional Golding story
bregman.carrier: Bregman's research quest + six Tongan boys + Peter Warner
bregman.movement: received story → doubt → search → archive discovery → real story → changed meaning
bregman.craft: research process becomes story only because searching itself contains events, false leads and discovery
bregman.cripminds_use: excellent model for evidence-driven progressive discovery
bregman.caution: do not make source-hunting itself visible unless it genuinely functions as story

bregman.title: What if we give children the freedom to play and learn on their own?
bregman.movement: problem → alternative place → evidence/context → wider implication
bregman.craft: concrete institution arrives quickly after broad question; short form does not pretend to be full narrative
bregman.caution: explicit moral conclusion is stronger than owner typically prefers

bregman.title: An Inconvenient Truth About AI
bregman.form: long argumentative essay with narrative anchors
bregman.carrier: Gore's chart/lift; AI capability graph; author's own use
bregman.movement: historical scene → analogy → evidence → counterarguments → policy
bregman.craft: converts abstract capability growth to human time; alternates charts, examples, personal experience and political argument
bregman.cripminds_use: model for making quantitative change mentally graspable
bregman.caution: heavy polemic and repeated rhetorical pressure are not owner target

bregman.title: Abolish the Tobacco Industry
bregman.opening: scale claim followed by jumbo-jet analogy
bregman.movement: scale → familiar analogy → invention/history → industry mechanism → call to action
bregman.craft: makes enormous statistics concrete before expanding the history

bregman.title: The incredible story of Benjamin Lay
bregman.opening: precise dated action scene in a Quaker meeting
bregman.craft: classic character-led narrative built from documented historical action
bregman.cripminds_use: model for NARRATIVE_FEATURE when evidence supports scenes
bregman.caution: scene richness depends on source material; cannot be fabricated

bregman.title: No, you’re not fine just the way you are
bregman.movement: provocation → framework → examples/history → call to action
bregman.craft: explicit framework can carry a chapter when reader knows the argument is the product
bregman.cripminds_use: model for explanatory/reportorial essay, not default narrative
bregman.caution: direct exhortation is more forceful than Crip Minds owner preference

bregman.title: Quit ChatGPT: right now!
bregman.movement: call → evidence → historical boycott logic → action
bregman.cripminds_use: evidence for ARTICLE_FORM selection; not every piece should simulate narrative nonfiction
bregman.caution: not suitable as prose model for normal Crip Minds features

scientias.title: Sporten vermindert angst en verbetert je humeur: zo werkt dat
scientias.explanation_move: exerkines introduced, then AEA/2-AG/BDNF immediately glossed

scientias.title: Helft van de synapsen verdwijnt tijdens winterslaap en toch weten muizen alles nog
scientias.explanation_move: defines synapse in ordinary language before structural detail; question emerges from contradiction

scientias.title: Een blik in de toekomst van ons zonnestelsel: exoplaneet overleeft dood van zijn ster
scientias.explanation_move: links white-dwarf system to future of solar system
scientias.craft_use: good relevance framing, more newsy than narrative

scientias.title: Voor het eerst atmosfeer ontdekt in bewoonbare zone van rotsplaneet
scientias.explanation_move: atmosphere importance first, helium detection mechanism after reason-to-care

scientias.title: Voor het eerst radiostraling ontdekt die afkomstig lijkt te zijn van een exoplaneet
scientias.explanation_move: explains electron/magnetic-field mechanism immediately after finding

scientias.title: Voor het eerst ooit ontdekt: een planeet die in een loodrechte baan om twee sterren draait
scientias.explanation_move: uses plain spatial picture before terminology ('polaire planeet')

scientias.title: Nieuwe gasreus ontdekt bij nabije ster: ‘Het mooiste is dat we hem al die tijd over het hoofd zagen’
scientias.explanation_move: old/new observations and archive surprise
scientias.craft_use: useful for explaining method from concrete discovery

scientias.title: Zo ontstaat een gewoonte in onze hersenen
scientias.explanation_move: coffee/gym/nail-biting before brain circuits

scientias.title: Deze bijzondere exoplaneet kan ons nieuwe inzichten geven over hoe het leven ontstaan is
scientias.explanation_move: defines super-Earth and why proximity matters

scientias.title: Voor het eerst zien natuurkundigen lang voorspeld zwaartekrachteffect in de kwantumwereld
scientias.explanation_move: first explains two theories in plain language, then experiment at their boundary

scientias.title: Hoe een 40.000-jarige cyclus ervoor zorgt dat het ijs op Antarctica invloed heeft op het klimaat rond de evenaar
scientias.explanation_move: large-scale relation stated first, mechanism follows
scientias.craft_use: good for causal explanation; not narrative

scientias.title: Ster in doodsstrijd gefotografeerd: de adembenemende Leeuwennevel in nieuw licht
scientias.explanation_move: moves from familiar object to instruments and interpretation

scientias.title: Vaak bewegen is belangrijker dan hard bewegen voor je mentale gezondheid
scientias.explanation_move: explains why prior studies cannot establish sequence before new design
scientias.craft_use: excellent methods clarification in ordinary language

scientias.title: Fossiel dat in 1948 bij de Noordpool werd achtergelaten blijkt van gigantisch onbekend dier
scientias.explanation_move: 1948 discovery → abandonment → 1984 rediscovery → modern analysis
scientias.craft_use: closest Scientias sample to narrative-feature craft

scientias.title: Stadsdieren worden brutaler
scientias.explanation_move: ducks/pigeons/rats perception → meta-analysis

scientias.title: Deze AI-arts stelt vaker de juiste diagnose dan een doorgewinterde dokter
scientias.explanation_move: what system does before model/agent terminology

scientias.title: Seks in de ruimte: waarom wetenschappers zich nu al zorgen maken
scientias.explanation_move: science-fiction expectation → real reproductive constraints

scientias.title: Waarom het brein van de inktvis verschrompelt in de oceaan van de toekomst
scientias.explanation_move: context first, then unexpected discovery and experimental origin

scientias.title: Blinde vlek in de oceaan? Deze negentien haaien doen wat boeien en satellieten niet kunnen
scientias.explanation_move: satellites/buoys limitation → tagged sharks → model improvement

scientias.title: Belangrijk kantelpunt bereikt: voedselketen in Noordelijke IJszee blijvend verstoord
scientias.explanation_move: defines tipping point in plain Dutch then causal chain ice→sunlight→nitrate→food web

craft_sources.source: UC Berkeley Journalism — Introduction to Reported Narrative
principles: separate story architecture, paragraph pacing, sentence rhythm and word choice
character, scenes, tension, transitions and narrative line are distinct tools
narrative techniques must remain reported nonfiction
craft_sources.exercise: Annotate one feature at four levels: whole-story structure, paragraph pacing, sentence rhythm, word choice.

craft_sources.source: UC Berkeley Journalism — Intro to Narrative Writing
principles: report for narrative
keep narrative true to reporting
scene/dialogue/tension/background depend on reporting
craft_sources.exercise: For a candidate story, list what scene material is actually reported versus merely desired.

principles: facts are the building blocks of literary nonfiction
scene-by-scene construction can be used in journalism
multiple forms: profile, investigative, magazine feature
craft_sources.exercise: Convert the same reporting into a short profile outline and an explanatory feature outline; compare fit.

craft_sources.source: The Open Notebook — Naming the Dog: The Art of Narrative Structure
principles: the hardest choice is often which story to tell from a large research pile
structure can be planned or discovered; no single method
complex science often benefits from alternating hard material with easier narrative
craft_sources.exercise: From one research pack, outline 3 genuinely different possible stories before selecting one.

craft_sources.source: The Open Notebook — Writing Elegant Background
principles: background can be block or braided/zipper
answer reader questions when they arise
jargon should be introduced slowly and from familiar ideas
craft_sources.exercise: Mark every background paragraph: needed now / needed later / unnecessary.

principles: too much explanation collapses story structure
give neither too little nor a semester-long lecture
disperse massive explanations or tell the story of how an explanation was discovered
craft_sources.exercise: Delete explanation until a nonexpert first becomes confused; restore only that missing layer.

craft_sources.source: The Open Notebook — Nailing the Nut Graf
principles: orientation can be explicit without being banal
no single position/length formula
move between narrow anecdote and wider meaning
craft_sources.exercise: Write three orientation strategies for the same story: immediate nut, delayed nut, no separate nut.

principles: transitions connect ideas but should not become afterthoughts
transition type should follow logical relation
visible formulaic transitions expose scaffolding
craft_sources.exercise: Remove every explicit signpost from a draft; add back only the transitions whose absence causes a real jump.

principles: ending deserves as much care as lede
callbacks and new moments can work when earned
sometimes the best ending is already a paragraph or two earlier
craft_sources.exercise: Test the draft ending, then versions cut one and two paragraphs earlier.

craft_sources.source: Poynter — Show and Tell / Ladder of Abstraction
principles: move deliberately between concrete and abstract
bureaucratic middle abstraction is dangerous
meaning needs concrete exemplification
craft_sources.exercise: Label each paragraph low/mid/high on abstraction ladder; inspect stretches stuck in the middle.

principles: slow information pace for clarity
vary sentence length for pacing
space strong material through story rather than front-loading it
craft_sources.exercise: Mark 'gold coins' in a feature and test whether strong material is distributed or front-loaded.

principles: scene and summary are different modes
both are necessary; overreliance on either weakens nonfiction
reflection is a third mode
craft_sources.exercise: Label passages SCENE / SUMMARY / REFLECTION; identify accidental hybrids doing too much at once.

craft_sources.source: Nieman Storyboard — Reporting and Writing Scenes
principles: scenes are reporting products, not prose inventions
raw scenic detail must be collected deliberately
specific moments/actions support immersive narrative
craft_sources.exercise: For every proposed scene, require a 'scene-capable evidence' checklist before writing.

craft_sources.source: Nieman Storyboard — Reverse Engineering and Story Construction
principles: reverse engineer strong stories into parts and purposes
different sections use different tools
story building can be decomposed without becoming formulaic
craft_sources.exercise: Take a strong feature and write one sentence describing the job of every section.

craft_sources.source: Nieman Storyboard — How 5 Journalists Structured Their Stories
principles: structure follows reporting material and purpose
chronology is often best for complicated subject matter
mood/character/argument may demand different structures
craft_sources.exercise: Try chronological versus braided ordering on the same evidence and blind-compare comprehension.

principles: scene, summary and exposition are distinct narrative functions
summary compresses time; exposition pauses to explain
sequencing these modes is a central design choice
craft_sources.exercise: Represent a draft as a necklace of S(scene), M(summary), E(exposition); inspect long unbroken runs.
